plain_english_policy: Mandatory private insurance purchase with no explicit public alternative stated.

effects.rationale: Penalties for non-compliance (likely fines or taxes) disproportionately burden low-income individuals who cannot afford insurance, even if premium subsidies exist. No explicit progressive tax structure is mentioned.
Explicitly focuses on *requiring* private insurance purchase, with no mention of public programs or government-run healthcare.
Imposes a financial obligation (via penalties) on individuals who might otherwise opt out of insurance, effectively restricting their autonomy to forgo private coverage.
Aligns with employer-provided or capital-driven healthcare systems (e.g., penalties may incentivize employers to offer insurance as a benefit).

evidence_quote: "requiring individuals to purchase health care insurance"
